propositions: Jira rebar-id label is written before local CREATE event and binding are durably published, causing permanent unbound_jira drift when ephemeral runner loses final push and all local state

When labeled snapshot persists but local binding store entry is lost, the L10 guard unconditionally stands down, preventing all automated healing paths (binding_walk guard, differ suppression, BindingRecovery)

Recovery extension detects marked-but-unstored key by matching label to deterministic inbound id with no binding-store entry and no local ticket, then replays adopt through existing _apply_inbound_create leaf
Idempotent replay pattern ensures re-materialized local ticket and binding converge on same deterministic local id without duplicate labels
Safety scoping preserves stand-down for foreign markers, multi-marker keys, pending entries, existing local tickets, and retired keys; fsck continues alerting until binding exists
